variants.name: Running
variants.summary: Mid-run: the progress toast reads Deploying web-app…, the heading reads Deploying, and the logs card streams under the Building status.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The routing rules were refused: the heading reads Failed, the danger Alert carries the reason with Edit and Redeploy, no toast repeats it while the page is on screen (a hidden page gets the permanent failure toast), and the logs card stays open on the failed step with the Phased or Complete switch.

variants.name: Success
variants.summary: The run is live: the heading reads Deployed and the success Alert names the new address with Edit, Redeploy and Open service, no toast repeats it while the page is on screen, and the logs card is gone.
